title: Checking / doubt
prompt: I already locked the front door and checked the stove, but what if I didn't and the house burns down? I need to go check again.
baselineRules: Checking the lock or stove once, and confirming it, is sufficient.
A single verification is complete evidence; repeating adds no new information.
Doubt is a feeling, not a reason to re-check.
If I checked once, it is done.
